test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Madhubala said to Dillip, "I had a very sumptuous meal yesterday."

options.text: Madhubala told Dillip that she had had a very sumptuous meal the day after.
Madhubala told Dillip that she had had a very sumptuous meal the following day.
Madhubala told Dillip that she had had a very sumptuous meal the previous day.
Madhubala told Dillip that she had a very sumptuous meal the previous day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Madhubala told Dillip that she had had a very sumptuous meal the previous day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I had" becomes "she had had"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to &a
